He speaks with David Gura & Isabelle Lee on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.summary: Robert Mitchnick, head of digital assets at BlackRock, joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." Hackers have stolen more than $130 million worth of Bitcoin from thousands of supposedly secure cold wallets in recent days. The Coldcard wallet hack may strengthen the case for spot Bitcoin ETFs by undermining confidence in self-custody among investors. (Source: Bloomberg)

Bloomberg's Kurt Wagner joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: OrbiMed trims MBX Biosciences (MBX) position to 6.4% after share sales
general.summary: OrbiMed Advisors and its affiliates have reduced their beneficial ownership in MBX Biosciences (MBX) to 6.4%, down from a previous stake, following a series of open-market share sales between June 29 and August 7, 2026. The sales, executed at prices ranging from $53.48 to $68.29 per share, prompted the filing of an amended Schedule 13D/A. Despite the reduction, OrbiMed retains an Investors’ Rights Agreement with MBX, granting them demand, Form S-3, and piggyback registration  [sentiment: Neutral]

general.title: MASS (MASS) investor Christopher Brown plans 100,000-share stock sale

These shares were originally acquired as founder's shares and will be sold through Morgan Stanley Smith Barney LLC. The filing also notes prior sales made by Brown under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. [sentiment: Neutral]
